text_en: How do I locate my card?
text: Enoda card-ai naan eppadi kandupidikkuthu?

text_en: Why won't my card show up on the app?
text: Enoda card yen app-la kaattala?

text_en: I need to know your exchange rates.
text: Unga maatru rates-ai naan therinthu kolla vendum.

text_en: I purchased something in a foreign currency but the rate applied is wrong
text: Naan oru velinaattu currency-la etho vaanginen, aanaal payanpaduthappatta maatru rate thavaranaathu.

text_en: My statement has Rs 10 I have been charged showing up on it.
text: Enoda statement-la enakku charge panna Rs 10 kaattuthu.

text_en: My withdrawl is still pending.  Why?
text: Enoda withdrawal innum pending-il ulladhu. yaen?

text_en: If I request that my funds be held, what currencies do you use?
text: Enoda panathai vaithirukka naan kettaal, neenga entha currencies use pannuveenga?

text_en: I need my card now!
text: Enakku ippo enoda card thevai!

text_en: When traveling, can I auto top-up my card at certain times?
text: Travel pannum podhu, specific times-la enoda card-ah auto top-up panna mudiyuma?

text_en: I've tried my card a bunch of times and it never worked.
text: Naan en card-ai pala thadavai try panni paathen, aana athu velai seiyave illa.

text_en: May I exchange currencies with this?
text: Idhai vachu naan currency exchange panna mudiyuma?

text_en: My entire gym bag, including my wallet, was stolen out of my locker today. Everything in my wallet is gone - how do I block the card to make it can't be used?
text: Inniku enoda locker la irunthu enoda wallet oda sethu gym bag muzhusa thiruttu poiduchu. Wallet la iruntha ellame pochu - card ah use panna mudiyatha padi eppadi block panrathu?

text_en: how old do i need to be to get an account for myself
text: Enakku endru oru account-ai thirappatharku enakku eththanai vayathaaha irukka veendum?

text_en: Are contactless payments enabled on my new card?
text: Enoda puthiya card-il contactless koduppanavugal seyalpaduthapattullatha?

text_en: new customer and filling gas today, it's not working, the thing shows pending half an hour!
text: Naan oru puthiya vaadikkaiyaalar, indru gas nirappukiren, athu velai seiyala, arai mani neramaaga pending endru kaattuthu!

text_en: I made a transaction this morning and would like to revert it.
text: Naan indru kaalai oru transaction seithen, athai thirumbap pera virumbugiren.

text_en: I payed with a card and was charged an extra fee
text: Naan card ai payanpaduthi cash seluthinen, atharku melathiga fee vasoolikapattathu.

text_en: Where can I obtain my virtual card?
text: Enoda virtual card-ai naan engu peralaam?

text_en: Will my card be accepted all over the world?
text: Enoda card ulagam muzhuvathum etrukkollappaduma?

text_en: I tried making an update to my balance using cheque just yesterday but it doesn't appear to have worked. Should this not be a faster process? I need you to please check over my account because something has went wrong.
text: Naan netruthaan cheque-ai payanpaduthi enoda balance-ai update seiya muyandren, aanaal athu velai seithathaga theriyala. Ithu innum vegamaana seyalmuraiyaga irukka vendaama? Etho thavaru nadanthullathaal please enoda account-ai saripaarkkavum.

text_en: I have a strange payment in my statement
text: Enoda statement la oru vithyasamana payment iruku.

text_en: I no longer live at my address on file, how do I change it?
text: Pathivilulla mugavariyil naan ippothu vasippathillai, athai naan eppadi maatruvathu?

text_en: What do I do with my card PIN?
text: Enoda card pin number-ai naan enna seyya veendum?

text_en: How can i get multiple disposble cards.
text: Naan eppadi pala disposable card-galai petrukkolvathu?

text_en: I think someone is using my card to make transactions I don't remember.
text: Enakku ninaivillaatha transactions-ai seivatharku yaaro enoda card-ai payanpaduthukiraargal endru naan ninaikkiren.

text_en: Do all ATMs take this card?
text: Ella ATM machine-galum indha card-ai accept pannuma?

text_en: Help me.  There is a Direct Debit that I didn't make.
text: Enakku uthavungal. naan seyyatha oru neradi patru ingay ullathu.

text_en: What do I do if I forget my passcode?  Because I did.
text: Enoda kadavukkureyeettai (passcode) naan maranthuvittaal naan enna seivathu? Yenendral naan athai maranthuvitten.

text_en: Can you tell me why you won't let me get my own money out of the money machine? I know I used the right PIN.
text: ATM iyandhirathilirundhu enoda sondha panathai eduka neenga yen anumadhikalai endru enakku solla mudiyuma? Naan sariyana PIN-ai payanpaduthinen endru enakku theriyum.

text_en: My card payment is still on hold, why is it so?
text: Enoda card koduppanavu innum niruthi vaikkappattulladhu, adhu yen appadi?

text_en: My phone was stolen
text: Enoda phone thirudappattu vittathu.

text_en: I tried to make a transfer and it was declined. Why?
text: Naan oru transfer panna try pannen, aana athu decline aayiduchu. Yen?

text_en: The refund isn't showing up on my account.
text: Enoda account-la thirumbap petra cash kaattavillai.

text_en: My credit card was declined.
text: Enoda credit card niragarikkapattathu.

text_en: I did transfer, why is it pending
text: Naan transfer panniten, yen athu pending-la irukku?

text_en: What do I do if an ATM "stole" my card?
text: ATM machine enoda card-ai "eduthukondal" naan enna seiya vendum?

text_en: What kind of cash machines would allow me to change my PIN?
text: Entha vagaiyaana ATM iyandhirangal enoda PIN ilakkathai maatra anumadhikkum?

text_en: I've tried numerous times to submit a transfer of funds. Why isn't it going through?
text: Naan palathadavi money transfer seiya try panniyean. Athu yen innum pogalai?

text_en: dont understand why transfer failed
text: Panamaatram yaen tholviyadainthathu endru puriyala

text_en: Would it be possible to get another card?
text: Enakku innoru card pera mudiyuma?

text_en: How do I receive my physical card
text: Enoda physical card-ai naan eppadi pettrukkolvathu?

text_en: can i get a description of how to use a disposable virtual card
text: Oru disposable virtual card-ai eppadi payanpaduthuvathu enbathu patriya vilakkathai pera mudiyuma?

text_en: I made a transfer a few hours ago from a local bank account.  I do not yet see the transfer.  Please check on this for me.
text: Naan konjam nerathuku munnadi local bank account-la irundhu transfer pannen. aana adhu innum kaatala. please idhai check panni sollunga.

text_en: Think someone has took money out with my card. What shall I do?
text: Yaro enoda card-a vachu cash eduthitanga nu nenaikuren. Naan enna seiyanum?

text_en: Is there an exchange fee?
text: Currency maatru fee edhum ulladha?

text_en: Could you please activate my card
text: Thavu seithu enoda cardai activate seiya mudiyuma?

text_en: I see some fees for cash withdraw.
text: Cash eduppatharku sila kattanangal aravidappattiruppathai naan kaankiren.

text_en: Am I able to order a new card and have it sent to me in China?
text: Ennal oru puthiya card-ai munpathivu seithu athanai China-vukku anuppa vaikka mudiyuma?

text_en: Is the top up feature available on the Apple Watch?
text: Apple Watch il top-up seyyum vasathi ullatha?

text_en: I live in the US but want to get a card
text: Naan amerikaavil vasikkireen, aanal oru card pera virumbukireen.
